question: If ((25)/(9))x⁺¹((81)/(625))x⁻¹=(9)/(25) , then find the value of x.
solution:
**Calculations:**

((25)/(9))x⁺¹((81)/(625))x⁻¹=(9)/(25) 

⇒((25)/(9))⁽x ⁺ ¹⁾((9²)/(25²))⁽x⁻¹⁾= ( 9)/(25)

⇒(frac{25⁽x⁺¹⁾}{9⁽x⁺¹⁾})(frac{9²⁽x⁻¹⁾}{25²⁽x⁻¹⁾}) = ( 9)/(25)

⇒ frac{9²⁽x⁻¹⁾⁻⁽x⁺¹⁾}{25²⁽x⁻¹⁾⁻⁽x⁺¹⁾} = ( 9¹)/(25¹)

⇒ ((9)/(25))²⁽x⁻¹⁾⁻⁽x⁺¹⁾ = (( 9)/(25))¹

If the basis are same then the powers on left side and right side are also equal

⇒ 2(x - 1) - (x + 1) = 1

⇒ 2x - 2 - x - 1= 1

⇒ x = 4

**Hence, The Required value of x is 4.**
